tasks.subject: Task 1: Lint tooling & repo config
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Establish pinned, reproducible lint/format tooling and shared config so every later task can self-verify shellcheck/shfmt cleanliness.

**Files:**
- Create: `tests/install-lint-tools.sh`
- Create: `tests/lint-tools.sha256` (generated by running the installer once)
- Create: `.gitignore`
- Create: `.editorconfig`
- Create: `.shellcheckrc`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `./tests/install-lint-tools.sh` downloads shellcheck v0.10.0 and shfmt v3.10.0 into `bin/` and exits 0.
- [ ] `tests/lint-tools.sha256` exists, committed, lists both binaries' SHA256.
- [ ] Re-running the installer verifies against the lockfile and exits 0 (no re-download).
- [ ] `./bin/shellcheck --version` and `./bin/shfmt --version` print the pinned versions.
- [ ] `bin/` is gitignored.

**Verify:** `./tests/install-lint-tools.sh && ./bin/shellcheck --version && ./bin/shfmt --version && git check-ignore bin`

```json:metadata
{"files": [".gitignore", ".editorconfig", ".shellcheckrc", "tests/install-lint-tools.sh", "tests/lint-tools.sha256"], "verifyCommand": "./tests/install-lint-tools.sh && ./bin/shellcheck --version && ./bin/shfmt --version && git check-ignore bin", "acceptanceCriteria": ["installer fetches shellcheck v0.10.0 + shfmt v3.10.0 into bin/ and exits 0", "tests/lint-tools.sha256 committed with both hashes", "re-run verifies against lockfile, exits 0", "./bin/shellcheck and ./bin/shfmt report pinned versions", "bin/ is gitignored"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Runtime scripts shellcheck + shfmt clean
tasks.description:

**Files:**
- Modify (formatting/lint only): `shai`, `shai-read`, `shai-context`, `shai-eval`, `shai-dispatch`, `shai-print`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `./bin/shellcheck` reports zero findings on all six runtime scripts.
- [ ] `./bin/shfmt -d` produces no diff on all six runtime scripts.
- [ ] The existing `./tests/tests.sh` still passes (behavior unchanged by reformatting).

**Verify:** `./bin/shellcheck shai shai-read shai-context shai-eval shai-dispatch shai-print && ./bin/shfmt -d shai shai-read shai-context shai-eval shai-dispatch shai-print && ./tests/tests.sh`

tasks.subject: Task 9: tests/conventions.sh checker
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add a locally-runnable conventions/hygiene checker enforcing the project's own standards, and make the repo pass it.

**Files:**
- Create: `tests/conventions.sh`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Checks: #!/bin/bash shebang on every script; `set -euo pipefail` on the six runtime scripts; executable bit on runtime scripts + tests/run.sh + tests/test_*.sh; tools.json valid JSON; no trailing whitespace and a final newline on every tracked text file.
- [ ] `./tests/conventions.sh` exits 0 on the current repo.
- [ ] The checker is itself shellcheck + shfmt clean.

**Verify:** `./tests/conventions.sh && ./bin/shellcheck tests/conventions.sh && ./bin/shfmt -d tests/conventions.sh`


tasks.subject: Task 10: CI workflow ci.yml
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add the strict 4-job CI gate on push + PR, using the pinned lint tools.

**Files:**
- Create: `.github/workflows/ci.yml`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Triggers on push and pull_request.
- [ ] Four jobs — test, shellcheck, shfmt, conventions — each running its exact local command; any failure fails the build.
- [ ] The shellcheck/shfmt jobs install pinned tools via `./tests/install-lint-tools.sh` and invoke `./bin/…`.
- [ ] YAML parses, and every referenced command passes when run locally.

**Verify:** `./tests/run.sh && ./tests/install-lint-tools.sh && ./bin/shellcheck shai shai-read shai-context shai-eval shai-dispatch shai-print tests/*.sh && ./bin/shfmt -d shai shai-read shai-context shai-eval shai-dispatch shai-print tests/*.sh && ./tests/conventions.sh` (full green-CI confirmation happens on push).

```json:metadata
{"files": [".github/workflows/ci.yml"], "verifyCommand": "./tests/run.sh && ./tests/install-lint-tools.sh && ./bin/shellcheck shai shai-read shai-context shai-eval shai-dispatch shai-print tests/*.sh && ./bin/shfmt -d shai shai-read shai-context shai-eval shai-dispatch shai-print tests/*.sh && ./tests/conventions.sh", "acceptanceCriteria": ["triggers on push and pull_request", "four jobs test/shellcheck/shfmt/conventions, all blocking", "lint jobs install pinned tools and use ./bin", "YAML parses; every job command passes locally"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```
